Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Writing Pen & Pin Lot - 9 Pieces
Sheaffer, Ellington Pens, Cross, Calligraphy Set
Vintage and Modern Mixed Collection
A diverse collection of fine writing instruments and calligraphy tools featuring prominent makers such as Sheaffer and Cross alongside a complete dip pen set. This lot offers a mix of professional office pens, vintage 10K gold-filled mechanical pencils, and artistic lettering tools, making it an excellent starter kit for pen enthusiasts or a varied addition to a stationary collection.
Items Included:
Sheaffer Silver-Toned Pen: Single ballpoint pen in original red presentation case with an Allegiance lapel pin.
Ellington Pens Teal & Black Pen: Modern writing instrument with gold-toned trim in a dedicated black box.
Cross Pen & Pencil Set: 4 instruments including 10K gold-filled and black finishes with lead refills and erasers in a Cross case.
Calligraphy Gift Set: Features 1 feather quill, 1 wooden dip pen handle, 5 interchangeable nibs, and 4 bottles of ink.
Condition:
Overall very good condition. The Sheaffer and Ellington pens appear well-maintained in their respective boxes. Cross pens show light surface wear and some adhesive residue on one barrel. The calligraphy set appears mostly unused; ink bottles are sealed or full. Cases show minor exterior shelf wear. None of the pens have been tested for ink flow or functionality.

Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging

Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

description: This vintage mid-century pipe smoker's set includes a cork and brass base, a brass lidded tobacco jar showing visible patina and oxidation inside, a wooden and plastic smoking pipe, and two brass pipe rests. The brass components display tarnish and wear consistent with age, and the pipe shows signs of use. The cork base has pads on the underside for stability. The set features classic mid-century modern design elements and visible flaws include patina inside the jar and tarnish on the brass parts.

Natural Mineral Specimens
Comprehensive Geological & Decorative Rock Collection
Natural Crystal, Polished Agate, and Identified Mineral Set
Largest piece approx. 9" x 8" | Total weight 8 lbs
Natural Specimens
This diverse geological collection features a substantial white crystal cluster exhibiting complex geometric terminations and a rugged natural matrix. Complementing the central specimen is a polished blue agate slice with concentric banding and a central crystalline pocket. The lot includes a vintage educational mineral set containing twenty distinct specimens-such as Obsidian, Petrified Wood, and Fluorite-each accompanied by descriptive geological data. An extensive assortment of raw and tumbled gemstones in various colors and textures provides a broad survey of mineralogy suitable for display or study.
Identification set includes specimens from regional locales including Arizona, Brazil, and Colorado.
Large crystal cluster showcases prominent tabular crystal growth and lustrous surfaces.
Agate slice features a vibrant teal-dyed hue highlighting the natural chalcedony layers.
Collection includes a wide variety of silicate and carbonate minerals in tumbled and raw forms.
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Natural mineral specimens show expected inclusions, varied textures, and minor surface friability inherent to their geological formation. The identification box and key show light shelf wear consistent with age but remain fully legible and intact. Agate slice and tumbled stones are well-polished.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
